payload.dedup_note: LCME precision/cold-start/source-class findings overlap the 04:21 peer shard and receive zero additional earned-work credit here.
payload.unique_summary: Persistent data can exist yet remain cognitively unavailable; isolated stores can preserve bytes while losing cross-session recall; Titan suffered 6675 orphaned edges; MemoryHub later demonstrated logical federation across physical stores; crash-resumable backfill and compatibility-preserving migration are reusable recovery patterns.

branch_feedback.unifieddb: Treat logical unification as identity/query/provenance/recovery unification, not mandatory physical merge. Require cross-store visibility and causal recall receipts.
branch_feedback.claygraph: Make referential integrity, orphan detection/repair, provenance and retrieval-layer ablation mandatory. More graph/vector machinery is not automatically better.
branch_feedback.harness: Add stored-but-unreachable memory, isolated-store cross-session loss, orphan graph, interrupted backfill, reconnect and migration-compatibility regression cases.
branch_feedback.frank: Count memory as functional only when it can enter cognition and measurably affect decision/outcome/re-entry.
branch_feedback.claycode: Version stable durable resource identities and learned interfaces across migrations; avoid silent semantic renames.
branch_feedback.gwt: Storage presence is not global availability; test memory retrieval through selection/broadcast/effect traces.
branch_feedback.clay: Reuse federation/recovery invariants, not Titan/LCME topology as a fixed final architecture.
